title: RAG-RST: Retrieved Exemplars as In-Context Discourse Schema for RST Parsing
abstract: arXiv:2610.22150v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In Rhetorical Structure Theory (RST), each edge of a discourse tree carries a nuclearity label, marking which span holds the central content, and a relation drawn from a closed inventory of functional categories. Neither label is a surface property: the same two clauses can be Elaboration or Background depending on rhetorical intent, and the boundary between them is fixed by annotation convention rather than by lexical cues. Predicting these labels therefore requires a formal discourse schema, and exposure to discourse-rich pretraining text does not supply it: given only a target EDU pair, a strong LLM recovers nuclearity at 0.794 F1 and relation at 0.738 F1. We propose RAG-RST, a retrieval-augmented framework that supplies this schema as in-context demonstration rather than through parameter updates, raising nuclearity to 0.846 F1 and relation to 0.788 F1 with no training. translated_title: RAG-RST：检索样例作为RST解析的上下文话语图式
translated_abstract: 在修辞结构理论（RST）中，话语树的每条边都带有一个核心性标签，用于标记哪个片段承载中心内容，以及一个从封闭的功能类别清单中选取的关系标签。这两个标签都不是表层属性：同样的两个子句依据修辞意图的不同可以是“阐述”或“背景”，而它们之间的边界由标注惯例而非词汇线索决定。因此，预测这些标签需要一个正式的话语图式，而接触富含话语结构的预训练文本并不能提供这一图式：仅给定一个目标EDU对，强大的大语言模型对核心性的恢复达到0.794 F1，关系达到0.738 F1。我们提出了RAG-RST，一个检索增强框架，它通过上下文演示而非参数更新的方式提供这一图式，在无需任何训练的情况下将核心性提升至0.846 F1，关系提升至0.788 F1。我们比较了两种配置：一种预计算策略……
tldr: 提出RAG-RST检索增强框架，通过检索样例作为上下文演示为大语言模型提供话语图式，无需训练即可将RST解析的核心性预测从0.794提升至0.846 F1、关系预测从0.738提升至0.788 F1。
en_tdlr: RAG-RST is a retrieval-augmented framework that supplies the formal discourse schema as in-context demonstrations via retrieved exemplars, improving RST parsing nuclearity to 0.846 F1 and relation to 0.788 F1 without any training.
